_source: Arabic for category labels WooCommerce cannot supply. Two groups, both found by derive-category-labels.py on 2026-08-11 and translated here rather than shipped wrong on the Arabic storefront: (a) five categories with no Arabic term at all, 28 products; (b) three categories whose Arabic term is just the English string copied over, 25 products. Keyed by the English label exactly as it comes out of WooCommerce, after HTML-unescaping.
_note: Worth a native check before launch, along with the rest of the Arabic product copy. The two collaboration names are transliterations of licensed titles, so confirm them against whatever wording Lush HQ uses in Arabic markets. 'Lavender Range/Sleepy' keeps Sleepy as a product-range name rather than translating it to 'sleepy'.
